entities.name: Query IspD/IspF
observations: 394 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular mass 42.48 kDa and pI 6.57.
Shares 55.5–56.2% identity over 99% sequence coverage with reviewed bifunctional IspD/IspF homologs Q310X3, Q72C30, and A1VDX6.
Pfam domains: IspD (PF01128) at residues 7–225, NTP_transf_3 (PF12804) at 6–142, and YgbB (PF02542) at 237–389.
Likely catalyzes both MEP cytidylyltransferase and ME-cPP synthase reactions; assignment is supported primarily by strong homology.
Likely requires a divalent metal cation, as reported for close curated homologs.
Predicted to function in the bacterial methylerythritol phosphate isoprenoid biosynthesis pathway, at steps 2 and 4 of six.

entities.name: Q310X3
observations: Reviewed Oleidesulfovibrio alaskensis bifunctional IspD/IspF homolog; 56.2% identity and 99.0% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated with EC 2.7.7.60 and EC 4.6.1.12 and a divalent metal cation cofactor.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The methylerythritol phosphate pathway produces IPP and DMAPP precursors for bacterial terpenoid/isoprenoid biosynthesis.
IspD performs step 2: MEP plus CTP forms 4-CDP-ME.
IspF performs step 4: CDP-ME2P forms ME-cPP and releases CMP.
